parsed.name: 文件项目存储系统
parsed.description: 一种基于文件的项目持久化存储组件，用于在实验数据工作流中保存项目属性、数据项关系以及相关数据文件路径，支持实验项目的数据组织、读取与长期归档。
parsed.description_en: A file-based project persistence component used in laboratory data workflows to store project properties, data-item relationships, and related data file paths, supporting experiment data organization, loading, and long-term archiving.

actions.description: 加载项目存储属性并解析可用的数据文件夹路径。
actions.description_en: Load project storage properties and resolve an available data folder path.

actions.description: 获取项目存储系统标识符。
actions.description_en: Get the project storage system identifier.

actions.description: 将项目存储信息编码为可持久化表示。
actions.description_en: Encode the project storage information into a persistent representation.
